description: This file defines the Goteo\Core\DB class, which extends PDO to manage database connections, including master and replica configurations, caching, and query statistics within the Goteo project.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A database handler class extending PDO, supporting caching, read replicas, and query statistics for the Goteo project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection, sets attributes, and configures read replica if available.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement, routing to read replica if applicable.

methods.name: getQueryStats
methods.description: Returns statistics about executed queries, including cached and non-cached counts.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Static method to activate or deactivate the internal SQL cache globally.

methods.name: replica
methods.description: Static method to activate or deactivate the use of read replicas globally.
